goal: Run one supported game across at least two physical PCs, with equal settings and verified improvement over the fastest participating PC alone.

milestones.title: Rust harness and failure tests
milestones.acceptance: Exact tile checks, bounded messages, timeout tests, fair local baseline, CI and two detractor rounds pass.

milestones.title: Transport on physical PCs
milestones.acceptance: Run the same harness on at least two user PCs. Record topology, binary identity, exact pixel checks, timing and limits.

milestones.title: Selected game baseline
milestones.acceptance: Confirm access to the game. Pin its build and settings. Record a repeatable local benchmark and capture.

milestones.title: Capture and replay game work
milestones.acceptance: Capture a real game's GPU work and resources. Replay a selected pass with verified output.

milestones.title: Split one game pass
milestones.acceptance: Execute one real game pass on two PCs. Track all resources and combine the result.

milestones.title: Game correctness and recovery
milestones.acceptance: Pass scene changes, motion, history, resource updates and worker failure tests at fixed quality.

milestones.title: Measured game benefit
milestones.acceptance: Beat the fastest participating PC at the same settings in a predeclared test. Report median, p95, input delay, quality and uncertainty.

milestones.title: Repeatable supported release
milestones.acceptance: A second operator repeats the game result from the instructions. Pin the supported hardware, game build and limits.
